name: Kettlebell Alternating Floor Press
steps: Lie on your back with feet flat and the bells beside your shoulders, resting against your forearms.
Press both bells up until your wrists are over your shoulders.
Keep one arm locked straight overhead while lowering the opposite elbow smoothly until the back of your upper arm touches the floor.
Press that kettlebell straight back up to full lockout beside the other bell.
Lower and press the opposite arm next, alternating sides with each repetition.
tips: Keep your elbows angled roughly 45 degrees from your torso rather than flaring directly out to the sides.
Maintain straight wrists so the kettlebell handles sit deep in your palms without bending your hands backward.
